# x402

Let AI agents fetch web pages, extract data and search the web with pay-per-request USDC payments over x402, through Circle Gateway, Agentic Market, or Inflowpay.

MrScraper offers pay-per-request HTTP APIs for AI agents, paid in USDC over [x402](https://www.x402.org/) v2. Buyers do not need a MrScraper API key or session cookie.

## Payment providers

Each payment provider has its own base URL, prices and settlement:

| Provider | Base URL | Price per request | Settlement | OpenAPI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Circle Gateway](https://docs.mrscraper.com/docs/integrations/x402/circle) | `https://api.mrscraper.com/v1/circle` | **0.001 USDC**; web-search **0.0003 USDC** | Circle Gateway batched payments. Settled before the service runs. | [`openapi.json`](https://docs.mrscraper.com/x402/circle/openapi.json) |
| [Agentic Market](https://docs.mrscraper.com/docs/integrations/x402/agentic-market) | `https://api.mrscraper.com/v1/cdp` | **0.001 USDC** | USDC on Base through the Coinbase CDP facilitator. Settled only on a successful response. | [`openapi.json`](https://docs.mrscraper.com/x402/agentic-market/openapi.json) |
| [Inflowpay](https://docs.mrscraper.com/docs/integrations/x402/inflowpay) | `https://api.mrscraper.com/v1/inflowpay` | **0.001 USDC**; web-search **0.0003 USDC** | InFlow facilitator, including payment from an InFlow balance. Settled only on a successful response. | [`openapi.json`](https://docs.mrscraper.com/x402/inflowpay/openapi.json) |

All three providers sell the same six `GET` tools: scrape-html, scrape-markdown, get-screenshot, scrape-brand, scrape-json and web-search. Each provider's page lists its endpoints.
